# Comprehensive Requirements Quality Checklist: Staff Authentication Views and Automatic Role-Based Redirect Guards

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality validation covering Security, Routing/UX, API Contracts, and Session Lifecycle before implementation  
**Created**: 2026-10-23  
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)  

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.  
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.  
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.  

---

## 1. Security & Perimeter Defense Requirements

- [ ] CHK001 Are role-based access control (RBAC) boundaries explicitly defined for all staff operational workspaces? [Completeness, Spec §User Stories 1-5, §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the server-side rejection mechanism specified with a standardized HTTP status code (403 Forbidden) for unauthorized cross-role API calls? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Are anti-enumeration requirements explicitly documented so that non-existent accounts and mismatched passwords return identical error responses? [Security, Spec §US1 Scenario 3, §FR-004, §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK004 Are email normalization rules (trimming whitespace and lowercasing characters) specified as mandatory prior to credential evaluation? [Clarity, Spec §US1 Scenario 2, §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK005 Is multi-tenant data isolation explicitly defined with strict filtering by authenticated `tenant_id` for administrative operations? [Completeness, Spec §US5 Scenario 2, §FR-009, §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK006 Are account suspension requirements documented to guarantee that inactive or suspended users cannot access any operational workspace? [Coverage, Spec §US1 Scenario 4, §US3 Scenario 2, §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK007 Are security audit logging requirements defined without storing or logging plaintext credentials or raw JWT tokens? [Compliance, Spec §US3 Scenario 3, §Session 2026-10-23]

---

## 2. Routing & Navigation Experience Requirements

- [ ] CHK008 Are the default post-authentication landing destinations unambiguously mapped to canonical URLs for all four roles (`/mostrador`, `/cocina`, `/admin`, `/catalogo`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the post-login routing behavior for unassigned or unrecognized roles explicitly defined to fall back safely to the dining catalog (`/catalogo`)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK010 Is browser history replacement (`replace: true`) mandated for all automatic role redirections to prevent back-button trap loops? [Consistency, Spec §US2 Scenario 1, §Edge Case 3]
- [ ] CHK011 Are deep link preservation requirements specified when an unauthenticated user attempts to access a valid URL matching their role? [Coverage, Spec §US2 Scenario 2, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK012 Are deep link discard requirements specified when the requested URL does not match the authenticated role's authorized workspace? [Clarity, Spec §US2 Scenario 3, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK013 Is silent redirection without intermediate error banners or content flashing required when an authenticated user attempts cross-role navigation? [Clarity, Spec §US4 Scenario 2, §FR-007]

---

## 3. API Contracts & Integration Requirements

- [ ] CHK014 Are the required request and response schemas for `POST /api/v1/auth/login` documented with exact wire properties (`access_token`, `token_type`, `expires_in`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §Contracts openapi.yaml]
- [ ] CHK015 Are the claims embedded in the JWT payload (`sub`, `email`, `role`, `tenant_id`, `token_version`, `iat`, `exp`) completely specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK016 Is token lifetime quantified with an exact duration of 8 hours (28,800 seconds)? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications Session 2026-10-23, §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK017 Are all error responses required to conform to the RFC 9457 `ProblemDetail` specification? [Consistency, Spec §US1 Scenario 3, §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK018 Are sensitive views and API responses required to emit `Cache-Control: no-store` headers to prevent browser caching of operational data? [Compliance, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the endpoint `GET /api/v1/auth/me` documented as the canonical contract for validating active session state and current user identity? [Traceability, Spec §Cross-Cutting Capabilities, §Contracts openapi.yaml]

---

## 4. Session Lifecycle & Invalidation Requirements

- [ ] CHK020 Is the single active session mechanism explicitly defined using a monotonic `token_version` validated against database state on every authenticated request? [Completeness, Spec §Cross-Cutting Capabilities, §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the failure behavior for stale or superseded token versions documented to return HTTP 401 Unauthorized? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK022 Are client-side HTTP 401 interception and local storage eviction requirements specified? [Coverage, Spec §Cross-Cutting Capabilities, §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK023 Is client redirection to `/login` with an expiration alert banner mandated upon session invalidation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, §Edge Case 1]
- [ ] CHK024 Is dual-tier shift termination specified, requiring both server-side token invalidation via `POST /api/v1/auth/logout` (returning HTTP 204) and client storage clearance? [Completeness, Spec §Cross-Cutting Capabilities, §FR-012]

---

## 5. Edge Cases & Resilience Requirements

- [ ] CHK025 Are form submission debouncing requirements documented to prevent rapid multi-click duplicate authentication requests? [Edge Case, Spec §US1 Scenario 5, §Edge Case 2]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the handling of in-flight form submissions during token expiration explicitly defined? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Case 1]
- [ ] CHK027 Are simultaneous multi-tab synchronization requirements specified for immediate eviction when one tab terminates the session? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Case 5]
- [ ] CHK028 Are temporary network outage requirements defined for displaying retryable offline notices while retaining active session state? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Case 4]
- [ ] CHK029 Are empty or syntactically invalid input validation requirements documented to block network dispatch and highlight relevant fields? [Coverage, Spec §US1 Scenario 5, §FR-002]

---

## 6. Measurability & Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK030 Is post-authentication redirection performance quantified with a measurable threshold (< 500 ms under standard broadband)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK031 Can cross-role isolation enforcement be objectively verified with 100% test scenario pass criteria on both client and server tiers? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK032 Can the absence of password enumeration timing and payload leakage be objectively tested and verified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the vertical slice boundary clearly defined, explicitly separating authentication and routing from internal kitchen ticket/counter dispatch operational logic? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions & Out-of-Scope Boundaries]

---

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after reviewer evaluation confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied in `spec.md` and related design artifacts.
- Leave items unchecked (`[ ]`) when requirements require clarification, correction, or deeper stakeholder review.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a review gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- Items are numbered sequentially (`CHK001` to `CHK033`) for precise citation in code reviews and review comments.
